coverage_note: Read all turns from 00:09 to 1:07:17. Several Latin-transliterated stretches (01:49 PTT = خطيبتي; 03:07 amalit ha / amalit tilha; 04:49 alayhi salmik; 05:39 fin tain el tod = تنتين إلا تلت; 44:03 behre = بيحرق; 44:20 El nar, nar heret me = النار حرقتني; 46:03 nadafti nadafet / 46:08 nadafetha). Echoes / engine mishearings: echo: PTT = خطيبتي (01:49); echo: fin tain el tod = تنتين إلا تلت (05:39); echo: سجر = فجر (18:47); echo: قير لاو = غير لو (19:41); echo: سنان = سنين (36:17, though Amal reacted to سنان as teeth so scored); echo: عجل/عجا = أجو/أجا (40:30/40:37); echo: بهدئ = بيحرق (43:06). English-only meta discussion from 1:04:11 to 1:06:47.

rows.medi_said: خطيبتي شوي عيان، عيان is sick.
rows.why: Used masculine adjective عيان for feminine noun خطيبتي (engine wrote PTT at 01:49); Amal recast to عيانة.
rows.english: My fiancée is a bit sick.

rows.why: Repeated masculine adjective عيان for feminine خطيبتي after her 02:00 fix; Amal corrected again to عيانة.
rows.english: My fiancée is a bit sick.

rows.medi_said: amalit ha, I made amalit tilha, made for her soup, shoraba.
rows.why: Said amalit ha before self-correcting to amalit tilha (عملتلها) with -lha indirect object; Amal only typed ana 3meltelha shoraba in chat.
Put verb بيوجع before subject راسها after topic pronoun هي; Amal recast to هي راسها بيوجع.

rows.medi_said: I don't know how to say cough. She has a cough.
rows.amal_said: They say but كح. I say كحة.
rows.why: Asked how to say cough; Amal supplied كحة.

rows.medi_said: So I, I say alayhi salmik?
rows.why: Said alayhi salmik for الله يسلمك (Allah ysalmek); Amal let it pass on voice and typed allah ysallmek in chat.
rows.english: May God keep you safe (response to salametha).

rows.chat: el-yoam yoam el-5amees, tamanya 3ashara alfain u sitte u 3eshreen
rows.why: Dropped conjunction و between ألفين and ستة وعشرين; Amal let it pass on voice and typed alfain u sitte u 3eshreen.
Said تلات (three) instead of تنتين (two) for 1:40; Amal questioned it and he fixed to تنتين إلا تلت (engine wrote fin tain el tod).
Misheard Amal's عندكم as هون when echoing her question; she repeated لسه عندكم شوب؟
rows.english: Is it still hot where you are?

rows.amal_said: No, you can use the adjective. Or I worry. Do you wanna say I worry?
rows.why: Used present verb بنقلق instead of participle/adjective قلقانين for state 'we are worried'; Amal told him to use the adjective.
Started with singular قلقان after احنا before saying قلقانين, and Amal reinforced 'إحنا group. أها.'
Used preposition لـ instead of من with قلقانين (worried about/from a fire); Amal corrected to من نار (engine wrote Men not).
rows.english: We are worried about a fire.

rows.amal_said: no. There's another word for that.
rows.why: Used يبدأ for a fire starting; Amal said no, there is another word for that.

rows.medi_said: do I know how to say taking care or like caring for? I don't know how to say this right.
rows.why: Asked how to say taking care of; Amal supplied ديرت بالي.
Dropped possessive -i on بالي and fixed preposition على before خطيبتي; Amal recast to بالي على خطيبتي.
rows.english: I took care of my fiancée.

rows.why: Omitted fixed preposition على after ديرت بالي; Amal named the rule 'على. بدير بالي takes على.'
rows.english: I took care of my fiancée.

rows.medi_said: ديرت بالي على خطيبتي كل الصباح.
rows.why: Said MSA الصباح instead of dialect الصبح (sheet: morning | el-sube7 | الصبح); Amal typed kul el-subu7 in chat.
rows.english: I took care of my fiancée all morning.

rows.amal_said: دير بالك is actually the command form.
rows.why: Tried to use command form ديري بالك when asked for another sentence example; Amal explained دير بالك is the command form.
Used past tense عملنا after خلينا instead of bare present نعمل; Amal recast to نعمل.

rows.medi_said: خلينا نعمل الدرس إنه، uh, إنه تخطط-- uh, تخططي.
rows.why: Used إنه instead of relative pronoun اللي and present تخططي instead of past خططتي for 'the lesson that you planned'; Amal asked كيف يعني؟ and he realized it should be past.
rows.english: Let's do the lesson that you planned.

rows.medi_said: أنا راح، um, أعمله، uh, غلط كتير بس.
rows.why: Said أعمله غلط كتير to mean 'I will make a lot of mistakes / do it very wrong'; Amal let it pass.
rows.english: I'm going to make a lot of mistakes though.

rows.medi_said: Uh, عصا- is it، أسف؟ No. That's bird.
rows.amal_said: شو in sky؟ العصافير هي أس فيه بال sky. عصافير بس.
rows.why: Thought of عصافير when trying to recall the word for sky; Amal confirmed عصافير is birds in the sky.
Could not recall the word for sky; Amal supplied سما.
Said collective غيم instead of singular غيمة or plural غيوم; Amal prompted and he gave غيوم and she typed 8aima 8yoom.

rows.medi_said: When, when do you look at the sky? When do you watch the sky?
rows.amal_said: No، امتى بتتطل-- no، امتى بتتطلع على الشمس would be when do you watch the sky؟ امتى الشمس بتطلع؟
rows.why: Misunderstood Amal's امتى الشمس بتطلع؟ as 'when do you watch the sky' (confusing بتطلع with بتتطلع); Amal explained it means 'when does the sun go up?'.
rows.english: When does the sun come up?

rows.medi_said: does it has to do with Azan? No. Is it Azan?
rows.amal_said: أذان؟ No. أذان is the call to prayer. فجر.
rows.why: Could not remember الفجر (dawn) and guessed أذان; Amal said no and supplied فجر.
Said سجر instead of فجر (confirmed at 19:03 'Is it فجر or سجر؟'); Amal corrected to فجر.
Added لو to غير (confusing with حتى لو) to mean 'other than'; Amal said 'No لو. غير.'

rows.medi_said: غير الشمس و غيوم شو في.
rows.amal_said: بس غير شمس و يوم. شوفي.
rows.why: Put الـ on الشمس after غير when asking 'other than sun and clouds'; Amal recast to غير شمس وغيوم and confirmed at 20:30 no el-.
rows.english: Other than sun and clouds, what is there?

rows.medi_said: So غير شم- غير شمس الـ، الغيوم
rows.why: Dropped و and kept الـ on الغيوم after غير شمس despite Amal's recast غير شمس وغيوم; Amal let it pass.
Started with طيار (pilot) before self-fixing to طيارة (airplane), then asked if plural is طيور (birds) before saying طيارات.

rows.medi_said: بس في الـ، الـ، ليل سما. في الليل سما،
rows.chat: el-sma billail fi el-2amar u njoom, u 3itme
rows.why: Put time phrase before bare noun سما ('in the night sky' word-for-word from English); Amal recast to السما بالليل.

rows.chat: el-sma billail fi el-2amar u njoom, u 3itme
rows.why: Forgot the word for dark/darkness at night; Amal supplied عتمة.
Put واحدة before the noun شمس (واحدة شمس); Amal recast to just واحدة.
Used masculine تاني after feminine noun نجمة; Amal repeated تاني with questioning intonation and he fixed to تانية.
Omitted object pronoun -ها on بشوف in relative clause modifying أول نجمة; Amal prompted 'Point it back to نجمة' and he fixed to بشوفها.
rows.english: This is the first star I see today.

rows.medi_said: So since is لسـ-- لسا, right?
rows.why: Guessed لسا (still) for 'since'; Amal said no and supplied من at 28:59.
Guessed لـ for 'since'; Amal said no, لـ is until, and gave من for since.
Asked if 'it rains' is masculine/1st-person بمطر; Amal recast to feminine بتمطر.

rows.chat: min awal el-yoam, mattarat talat marraat
rows.why: Scrambled root letters of مطرت as maratat; Amal supplied مطرت.
Said الأول instead of الهوا (confirmed at 31:46 'What I say?' and Amal answered 'الأول'); Amal corrected to الهوا هون.

rows.medi_said: غير من because it's comparative, right?
rows.why: Used من instead of عن after غير for 'different from'; Amal corrected to عن.
Asked how to say 'it snows'; Amal pronounced and typed bittallej.

rows.amal_said: آخر المرة means the last of the time. The end of the time.
rows.chat: aa5er marra tallajat kaanat 2abel talat sneen
rows.why: Put الـ on المرة after آخر, which changes the meaning from 'the last time' to 'the end of the time'; Amal explained the rule.

rows.chat: aa5er marra tallajat kaanat 2abel talat sneen
rows.why: Used masculine كان for feminine subject آخر مرة; Amal prompted 'مرة is.' and he fixed to كانت.

rows.amal_said: No. ثلاث سنين الماضيين أو الماضيات would be for the last three years. Ago is قبل. So قبل ثلاث سنين.
rows.chat: aa5er marra tallajat kaanat 2abel talat sneen
rows.why: Used الماضي after ثلاث سنين to mean 'three years ago'; Amal said no and taught that 'ago' is قبل before the number and time unit (قبل ثلاث سنين).
Said سنان (teeth) instead of سنين (years); Amal asked 'What's سنان؟' and supplied سنين.

rows.chat: aa5er marra tallajat kaanat 2abel talat sneen
rows.why: Lengthened the vowel in the past feminine ending -at (تلجات instead of تَلَّجَت); Amal recast to تَلَّجَت.

rows.amal_said: إيش يعني عجل؟ ... عجا كتير الصباح؟ إيش يعني؟
rows.why: Used plural verb أجو (came) with singular masculine الهوا (and wrong verb choice for strong wind); he self-fixed verb agreement to singular أجا at 40:40 after Amal questioned it, then she prompted him to say 'was very strong'.
rows.english: The wind was very strong in the morning.

rows.why: Said MSA الصباح (at 40:30 and 41:01) instead of dialect الصبح (sheet: morning | el-sube7 | الصبح); Amal typed el-subu7 in chat.
Dropped/mispronounced ق and -ني in حرقتني when repeating Amal's النار حرقتني; Amal recast to النار حرقتني.
First said nadafti then nadafet without the object pronoun -ها for 'it' (الأرض); Amal prompted 'It.' and he fixed to nadafetha (نظفتها).

rows.medi_said: Is it the bee? Is it the bee plants? ... Yeah, what's زبيب؟
rows.amal_said: Z-z-zبيب is raisins, I think. Is... زريعة.
rows.why: Confused زبيب (raisins) with زريعة (plants); Amal explained زبيب is raisins and supplied زريعة.

rows.medi_said: I don't, أنا بعرف، ما بعرف.
rows.why: Could not remember the word for stone; Amal supplied حجر.
Used singular الشارع with feminine/plural adjective قديمة without el- when meaning 'the old streets'; Amal recast to الشوارع and confirmed القدام at 51:20.

rows.amal_said: Or just حجر. Are stone. ... الشوارع الإدام في أمريكا حجر.
rows.why: Translated 'were made with stone' literally as عملت مع حجر; Amal recast to simply predicating the material noun حجر (الشوارع القدام في أمريكا حجر).
rows.english: The old streets in America are (made of) stone.

rows.amal_said: So you could either say my favorite stone or my favorite using عندي. المفضل عندي.
rows.why: Attached possessive suffix -ي directly to adjective مفضل (مفضلي); Amal explained مفضل never takes a pronoun ending and must be المفضل عندي or حجري المفضل.
rows.english: The second stone was my favorite.

rows.why: Put الـ on حجري which already has a possessive suffix; Amal corrected 'حجري المفضل. No ال first.'

rows.amal_said: But al-mufaddal is an adjective, so it follows ders. ... هاد الدرس المفضل عندي.
rows.why: Dropped الـ from المفضل in هادا الدرس المفضل عندي; Amal explained المفضل is a definite adjective following الدرس.

rows.medi_said: كتابه المفضل، مش فيهن، ما فيهن.
rows.amal_said: مش هون. مش، مش في. مش هون.
rows.wrong: مش فيهن، ما فيهن (مش في هون)
rows.why: Used في as 'is' in 'isn't here' (مش في هون / ما في هون, transcribed مش فيهن); Amal corrected to مش هون and explained 'في is not is. في is there is.'
Garbled farewell expression يعطيكي العافية as عافيا فيكي (blending with الله يبارك فيكي); Amal recast to يعطيك العافية.
rows.english: May God give you strength / thank you for your effort.
